locked_decisions: Dashboard and My Learning are distinct jobs and routes.
Desktop uses a persistent learner rail; compact mobile uses Home, Learning, Discover, Progress, More.
The learner shell is light-default; Dark and System are device-local presentation variants.
A public program preview is read-only; explicit authenticated free enrollment is server-owned.
Program/module/activity access and prerequisite locks are server-authorized; route possession is not access.
Watch -> Reflect -> Implement -> Review -> Improve is the first-slice activity loop.
Progress, completion, evidence, enrollment, notification read state, session, and certificate issuance are canonical only when returned by their owning service.
Analytics and UI state never grant access or create progress/completion/payment/score authority.
Video coverage uses versioned unique watched intervals; the provisional 90% operating default is participation evidence, not mastery.
Course-completion certificates are not competency certification or official skill credentials.
Every supported mutation needs visible saving/processing/error/retry/expiry/offline behavior and safe input preservation.
Routine support recovery must not require founder intervention or raw database editing.
do_not_infer: paid checkout, payment, refund, entitlement, or commerce state
access grants beyond the controlled free-enrollment policy
autonomous or official AI scoring, mastery, rank, reward, streak, or leaderboard
real-call recording, upload, transcription, external AI processing, or provider activation
B2B manager, organization membership, tenant switching, or white-label UI
live coaching, appointments, deadlines, reminders, cadence, or schedule commitments
analytics as canonical progress, payment, access, notification, certificate, or evidence state
protected resource existence from a denied/locked response
known_gaps: No approved media, transcript, caption, or playback evidence is bundled.
Avatar upload/object-processing contract and exact provider gate remain to be activated.
Certificate issuance implementation and exact-current runtime evidence remain pending.
Plan/calendar projection semantics are not defined enough to invent dates or commitments.
Exact-current browser/device accessibility, PWA/offline, and staging evidence are not produced by this docs package.
No Figma, Canva, Lucid, Drive-upload, or Notion management artifact is claimed.
